mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user ( username, password, real_name, email, phone, avatar, status, roles, permissions, department, position, register_time, last_login_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{status}, #{roles}, #{permissions}, #{department}, #{position}, #{registerTime}, #{lastLoginTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET login_fail_count = IFNULL(login_fail_count, 0) + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET login_fail_count = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET lock_time = #{lockTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
